viewport.basis: EditorPrimitives: SDPG_World (pass pass-0127, pointer 000100000228dcc2d760) outputs SceneColor; active mip 0 payload Resources/000100000228d3652960.mip0.v000100000228dcc2d760.bin has extent 1280x888 and version equal to the pass; ViewRect 1280x720 at (0,0) lies fully inside the allocation. The same pass's GBuffer target has the same extent, confirming the known same-size sceneColor mapping.
viewport.source: camera-pass output binding plus active-mip SubresourceLayouts; maximum allocation area is never used to identify a camera

padding.note: Display-only crop to the recorded camera ViewRect. Allocation is the native texture extent; captured bytes, active-mip bounds and subresource addressing are unchanged. Bytes outside the rect are labelled, not removed.
